==Description==
'''A-165''' is currently the only scrapped entity from [[Section A]]

==Mechanics==
'''A-165''' once spawned would have placed itself inside a random locker and take stamina away from anyone who tried to hide in the locker it was in.

== Trivia ==

* The design was made all the way back in December
* The design's file name is stoic in Collese's (the designers) folders
** meaning this design was going to be used for a game Collese was making, its unknown what became of that game.
